protocol.cache: Cold clears HTTP browser cache only; warm reload retains HTTP cache. Three cold/warm pairs per controller.
protocol.readiness: atlasDiagnostics.marks.firstSceneReady, not first presented GPU frame
protocol.heap: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage after HeapProfiler.collectGarbage, main and workers separate
protocol.network: CDP Network events from page and dedicated workers; HTTP encodedDataLength only; worker startup briefly paused for instrumentation
protocol.excluded: Pilot pair without worker network capture excluded
limitations: backingStorageSize may overlap across shared buffers; do not sum as physical memory
OS RSS optional, may include browser-wide processes and compressed pages; not VRAM
